scenario.summary: Clearwater Technologies Group's fiscal 2025 results reflect severe and sustained reimbursement-rate pressure across its pharmacy, benefits, and care-delivery businesses, producing the thinnest margins in its reporting history (net margin of 0.4%).

facts.driver: continued reimbursement-rate reductions from government and commercial payors
facts.severity: net margin of 0.4% and operating margin of 1.1%, both compressed to levels management considers unsustainable without corrective action
